files.features: 120 real orders with fill and borders applied to 6,000 empty rows below them across columns A:N (the classic 'formatted whole columns' bloat), plus three cell notes. The used range reaches row 6,121.

24 invented business contacts with first/last name, company, title, email, mobile and work phones (555-01xx numbers reserved for fiction), full street address, website and free-text notes that contain extra emails and phone numbers.
Two customer lists side by side (30 in the CRM, 28 in billing) that mostly overlap. One billing name has a trailing space and one differs only in capitalisation.

Practice dataset: 60 invented employees (ID, name, email, department, title, office, hire date, salary, status) and a Departments sheet with a COUNTIF headcount. Carries the metadata a real HR file leaks: author, last modified by, company, manager, three custom properties and the saved folder path.
12 company calendar events from November 2026 to January 2027: timed meetings, an overnight offsite and all-day US holidays, with dates and times stored as real Excel date/time values.
Two sheets, rich text, formulas, charts, table and hyperlinks
Multiple horizontal and vertical merged ranges
Plain and rich shared-string runs on multiple sheets
Three worksheets with the 1904 workbook date system and built-in date formats.
1,000-row inline-string table from another producer
A styled Q3 report: merged title, custom fonts, filled header row, borders, a highlighted total column, red negative variances, a double-underlined total row and a frozen header.

Two hidden columns and one hidden row, a frozen header row and frozen label column, custom row heights, and currency formats. The hidden columns are why the visible quarters do not add up to the printed total - the case that separates a viewer reporting what Excel stores from one quietly dropping it.

Practice dataset: 40 invented products - SKU, Product, Category, Supplier, Warehouse, Qty On Hand, Reorder Point, Unit Cost, Unit Price, Last Restocked. About one in five items is below its reorder point.
Merged title/header ranges, a frozen top row, currency/percent/date number formats, and custom column widths - exercises exactly the metadata a data-view renderer keeps or drops.
A contact list with exact duplicates, case-variant duplicates, stray whitespace, inconsistent casing, and blank rows - the classic cleanup workload.

15 invoices where every amount, quantity, discount and balance is stored as text ("$1,250.00", " 12", "15%", "(120.50)"), so the SUM totals come out as 0. ZIP codes with leading zeros are text on purpose.
Worksheet protection (<sheetProtection> with the legacy 16-bit password hash) on both sheets. The cells are locked against editing but the data is fully readable.

Practice dataset: 250 invented office-supply orders from 2025 across four US regions - Order ID, Order Date, Region, State, Sales Rep, Segment, Category, Product, Units, Unit Price and a live Revenue formula. Frozen header, AutoFilter, USD and M/D/YYYY formats, plus an About sheet.
Two worksheets, SUM/variance formulas with cached values, typed columns. General-purpose sample for viewers, converters, and the compare tool.
Workbook structure protection (<workbookProtection lockStructure="1">). Sheets cannot be added, deleted, renamed, moved, or unhidden in Excel until it is removed.
